title: The 27 amendments to the U.S. Constitution
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: The amendments are the changes and additions the country has made to its Constitution since 1787. Knowing them by number makes news, history and civics lessons easier to follow, since people often name a right by its amendment.

How to hold it: Chunk by era. The ten amendments of the Bill of Rights come first, learned five at a time. Then come the early fixes (11 and 12), the three Reconstruction amendments after the Civil War (13, 14 and 15), the four of the Progressive Era (16 to 19), and the rest in small groups. Use a number-shape or number-rhyme peg for each: one is a lone speaker at a microphone, three is a crowded house, five is a hand raised to say no. Recall the number from the summary and the summary from the number, then come back on day 1, 3, 7 and 21.
This list has 27 items. Answer below, then check — the practice button generates fresh questions from the list itself.
